segments.he: ר' נחמן מטולטשין ז"ל אמר החילוק שבין חסידותנו לחסידות חב"ד שאצל חב"ד מעמיקים עד אצילות וכו' אבל אנ"ש אחר רבינו ז"ל מביא אותנו עמוק על הבודים להתבודד. א"ע בא חבד ?? טבאבט זייא. אריין טיף אין קבלה עולם אצילות וכו' ברסלבר חסידים טרייבט אריין טיף אוף דעם בו?. ציא האבין התבודדות.
segments.en: Moharan'as answered him: "Who told you to imagine that when you come home you will find it bright, warm, clean, and orderly — that your wife will receive you with 'Welcome, my love and my honor' and immediately prepare the table and serve you good tasty food — and that therefore when you come home and find everything topsy-turvy you become infuriated? You are painting yourself a completely overturned picture! Rather, you should paint yourself exactly this: when you come home you will find it dark, cold, unclean, and disordered — the entrance and the room muddy — and your wife will come to meet you and curse and scold you, and you will find nothing prepared for you. Paint yourself this picture exactly. And then when you come home and look — it is still not quite as dark and not quite as cold and not as disordered as you pictured — and your wife did not receive you as badly as you imagined — and as for food, you found bread and some soup. It will already be bearable for you." And so it was.
